brand_vibe: Feminine, blush/pink, floral-glam lash studio: neon 'Lash Bloom' cursive sign on a pink flower wall, neon 'Good Vibes' sign, pink decor and lighting inside Lux Stitch Embroidery. IG feed and Booksy photos both lean soft pink/blush and glam rather than dark moody. Chose the LIGHT template (Amani exemplar) as base, with a custom blush/rose palette (not one of the 5 pre-set DESIGN.md palettes, derived from the real studio photos): bg #fdf4f2, ink #3a2420, accent-deep #b1526a (rose mauve), accent-mid #c98a9c (dusty rose), accent-soft #f6dfe0 (petal pink). Dark bands (CTA final + footer) use a deep wine/plum gradient (#2a1420 to #1c0d14) instead of the exemplar's espresso brown.

research_note: Fase 1 research completed 2026-07-19. Primary sources: Instagram web_profile_info endpoint (x-ig-app-id header) for bio/contact/media, and the Booksy business page's embedded __NUXT_DATA__ JSON payload (parsed as a Devalue-style reference array) for services, reviews, hours, location, staff and photo library. Phone/email were searched for across IG, Booksy JSON, Yelp (blocked) and Facebook (blocked) without success; business is registered as an active Florida LLC per a web search of state records (Sunbiz), confirming Yesenia Amaya as manager, but no additional public contact info was found there either. Proceeding per pipeline rule: outreach registered as IG DM only, business not failed since sufficient real images and data were obtained.
